notes: Same at: an id-less in_review->planned rollback and a forward planned->claimed share a timestamp. Because core never finds an id-less setter, arm (i) of the arbitration cannot fire for it; and the two rows tie on every sort key before the id, so the sort compares None with a string and raises TypeError: the log is unreducible in core and in Java (both folds refuse, before and after the fix). This pins that the same-timestamp arm is unreachable through an id-less setter on the plain path; no lane-differing log was constructible for it.
